normal.name: Alice Valentine
normal.text: I've always been a big fan of what would now be called retro games, which... given I'm 41 and the first video game I remember playing is Phantasy Star on the Master System shouldn't shock anyone. I've never considered myself beholden to nostalgia and love modern games, but classics are classics.

normal.name: A "normal" Lina
normal.text: They are on PC, but my GPU is old and my CPU is a bottle neck. Many of the newer titles aren't running well, even on medium settings. I don't play many AAA, but as a content creator using an older rig, having a current gen console is really helpful for offsetting the load of more heavy games.

normal.name: Joni 🍓🏳️‍⚧️
normal.text: I still need to finish playing this game! (Estpolis II; known as Lufia II: Rise of the Sinistrals in the U.S. version). I still have my childhood SNES cartridge of Lufia and the Fortress of Doom; one of my first RPGs, yet not the first one I finished!
